comments.text:
It’s not that they’re hiding anything; there are simply so many of them that even Japanese people can’t keep track of them all.
That said, I do agree that you’re more likely to avoid regret if you just walk into a shop at random.
We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed the delicious meals and snacks.
It was a rediscovery for us as well. TU
